$comment: Secrets the Worker must have before a deploy is allowed, checked by
ops/check-secrets.mjs in CD. Most of these are `.optional()` in the Zod
schema so the Worker still boots without them — it just silently loses a
feature (no emails, shop returns 503, argon2 users cannot log in). That
silence is what this manifest exists to prevent.
`required` must match the keys the schema refuses to default; a unit test
fails if the two drift apart. The per-environment lists are a judgement
call about what that environment cannot be useful without.

notes.LEGACY_VERIFY_URL: Drop these two once no user row has a $argon2 hash; the old server goes with them.

notes.BREVO_API_KEY: Not expected: staging logs emails to the console instead of sending them.
notes.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: Not expected yet — add here once staging has test keys wired up.
